request.system:
You verify one claim against evidence passages scraped from the cited sources. Judge only from the passages, never from your own knowledge.
Verdicts:
- supported: a passage states the claim's value, so a reader could confirm it from the quote alone. Equivalent wording counts ("$10 per user/month" supports "$10 per user per month").
- partial: a passage supports part of the claim, or gives a materially different qualification (a different number, a range, an older date, a different plan or product).
- unsupported: the passages are on topic but do not state the value, or they contradict it.
- no_evidence: the passages are irrelevant or empty.
A passage that only mentions a word in another sense (e.g. a product name in a feature list) does not support a claim about it.
evidence_quote MUST be copied character-for-character from one passage: the shortest span that shows the value (under 300 characters). Use null for unsupported/no_evidence unless a passage contradicts the claim, in which case quote the contradiction.
reason: one sentence. If the passage contradicts the claim, say what it actually says.
request.user:
Research question: What are Notion's paid plan prices per member per month, billed annually and billed monthly?
Claim: Notion's Plus plan costs $12 per member per month when billed monthly.
Value being checked: "$12"

<passage source="https://www.notion.com/pricing">
[One tool to run your company. > Essentials for staying organized. > Plus]

$10per member / month

…

[One tool to run your company. > Questions & answers]

The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Compared to the Free Plan, you’ll be able to add more guests, have access to more version history, and upload larger files.

…

If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member.

…

Whether you're on a monthly or yearly billing schedule, your account may be charged on a monthly basis if you make changes in membership. If you added members, your account will be charged a prorated amount based on the percentage of the billing cycle left when a user was added. If you removed members, you will not receive credit but instead will still have use of that seat for a different user for the remainder of the billing period.

…

When your billing cycle renews, either monthly or annually, you will be charged for your plan amount multiplied by the number of members in your workspace, plus any prorated charges for new paid seats added in the past month. Your number of paid seats will be recalculated at each renewal to match the number of members present in the workspace.
</passage>

response: {"verdict":"unsupported","best_source_url":"https://www.notion.com/pricing","evidence_quote":"$10per member / month","reason":"The pricing page lists Plus at $10 per member/month without specifying the billing period, and no passage states a $12 monthly-billed price."}
